rawFindings.title: Incorrect additional offset set for BinaryExpression and LogicalExpression
rawFindings.explanation: The added line increases the desired offset for tokens after the operator to 1, which overrides existing offsets and can cause incorrect extra indentation in cases like binary/logical expressions spanning multiple lines. This introduces an indentation inconsistency that did not exist before.
rawFindings.suggestion: Remove the added line to preserve the existing offset logic that correctly handles indentation after binary/logical operators.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For a code snippet with a binary/logical expression split on multiple lines, the indentation after the operator is incorrectly indented by an extra level compared to before the change.
